notes: 0.3.20: Add a slab by cert and the screen shows its picture and a real Benchmark at that exact grade before you add it; the eBay sold search for graded cards is rewritten so their sales actually come back; slab photos are framed as slabs everywhere instead of squashed into a card-shaped box. The card panel has one Current price box with the Benchmark alone above it, a green check when they match and a yellow triangle when they don't, no engine warning list, a listings count that matches the Listings tab, and it re-reads the card the moment you Accept. The editable price is called Current price everywhere. In a lot, Benchmark is read-only beside a Current price you can type, the same cell every other table uses. Every Inventory and Lots row carries TCGplayer and eBay sold links. Inventory filters by who you bought from, people and lots alike. Sold is a tab inside Inventory now, and the old Sold link still lands there. Challenge Benchmark takes links and any length of reasoning.
